messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — multiple errors in us-west-2a egress observed. Symptoms: outbound requests failing, instance metadata/timeouts, spikes in 5xx for hosted API. Paging on-call.
alex.sre: on it. seeing alerts for NAT gateway unhealthy across a subset of subnets. creating incident channel.
maria-network: quick add — I can see a recent infra automation run (infra-automation-bot) modified route-table rtb-0a1b2c3d and removed the 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-01234567 entry for the private subnets in us-west-2a. looks like a tf apply rolled out a change to those subnets only.
jamie-oncall: confirmed. traffic to api-hosts in us-west-2a shows egress failures ~172s ago. quick mitigation plan: 1) re-add route to the standby NAT GW (rtb replace-route) or 2) spin up a NAT instance in the affected subnets until we rollback infra change. leaning replace-route first.
alex.sre: agree. Maria — what's the route-table diff? can you paste the snippet?
maria-network: here, from cloudtrail + route table diff:
```
- 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-01234567 (active)
+ 0.0.0.0/0 -> <removed> (no target)
```
and the terraform change has this commit msg: "remove unused nat for private subnets (us-west-2a)"
infra-automation-bot: Automated run by pipeline #4921 succeeded. Plan applied by ci-user.
alex.sre: ugh. looks like automation incorrectly targeted a subset of subnets. taking immediate action to restore egress.
jamie-oncall: running replace-route against rtb-0a1b2c3d to point to nat-0f9e8d7c (standby NAT in us-west-2a). command:
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0f9e8d7c
```
jamie-oncall: executing now.
jamie-oncall: replaced route — testing outbound from a few private instances.
jamie-oncall: outbound tests OK from two instances in private subnet-12a and subnet-13a. monitoring shows request success increasing.
alex.sre: good — start rolling health checks and confirm client-facing error rates dropping.
lee-dse: customer impact snapshot (so we can brief sales):
- Hosted API: ~8% of requests from us-west-2 showed 5xx between 12:34:10Z-12:40:22Z, peak until 12:36Z.
- Dedicated customers with reserved capacity in us-west-2a: 3 customers experienced transient egress failures (retries mitigated most traffic).
- Private deployments: 2 on-prem/VPC customers reported downstream timeouts (they're behind NAT gw in their VPCs).
sam-sales: flagging top account "OrbitPay" — they saw increased error rate, ops on their side opened support ticket.
maria-network: confirming no DNS changes — this was pure routing. cloud provider shows NAT gateway in AZ returned 'impaired' during the window. cause: automated removal of route made NAT unreachable for those subnets.
alex.sre: post-mitigation: re-added routes, traffic normalized, error rate back to baseline. keeping monitoring in watch for 30m.
jamie-oncall: starting handoff — I've applied the hotfix and validated egress for affected subnets. handing to alex.sre for post-incident cleanup and RCA.
jamie-oncall: oncall-log: mitigate->replace-route, notify infra team to revert automation change, notify sales & support with impact summary. :white_check_mark:
alex.sre: taking over. immediate next steps:
- revert the terraform change in CI (blocked for now until we validate scoping)
- add guardrail to infra-automation allowing route deletions only with explicit approval tag
- run retrospective and assign owner for follow-up
maria-network: I'm opening a quick PR to re-scope the TF module so it doesn't target per-AZ route tables blindly. will link PR here.
alex.sre: assign follow-ups: maria-network (PR + guardrail), infra eng to add pre-deploy check, reliability to run a canary for infra changes in staging if not already in place.
lee-dse: publishing customer impact note: short summary + timeframe + affected services. will tag support and sales. draft:
"12:34–12:40 UTC — egress failures for a subset of us-west-2a private subnets due to automated route removal. Impact: elevated 5xx for hosted API clients in that AZ and brief connectivity issues for a few Dedicated/Private customers. Mitigation: route re-added to standby NAT gateway at 12:36 UTC, traffic returned to baseline by 12:40 UTC."
sam-sales: thx — please DM me when the customer notes are live so I can update OrbitPay.
alex.sre: postmortem owner: maria-network + infra-eng (joint). please file incident ticket and link to this thread.
jamie-oncall: leaving the channel, monitoring for next 30m. ping me if anything regresses. :wave:
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. duration 6m. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 for RCA.
alex.sre: logging timeline into incident system and creating follow-up items. closing the live incident channel when RCA ticket created.
maria-network: PR created: "restrict-route-modification-to-intended-rtbs" — assigning infra-eng for review.
lee-dse: customer note posted to support portal and sent to affected customers. Sam, DM sent.
alex.sre: final checks green. closing thread once follow-ups are tracked. thanks all for quick response."
